listing.name: War of the Monsters — War of the Monsters Recompiled (yanm1103)
listing.summary: The project claims keyboard/gamepad fights, movies, sound and 60 FPS through a source build. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-U SCUS97197 disc and ELF.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the documented local Windows build using the wotm PS2Recomp submodule and your own extracted original files. These instructions do not establish a release package.

warnings: The project claims keyboard/gamepad fights, movies, sound and 60 FPS through a source build.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
